title: Thoracentesis entry site
view: The bare back of an adult seated and leaning forward over a padded bedside table with the forearms on a pillow, from behind, the patient's right on the image right (the ESP photo, equipment removed and re-posed); inset: one intercostal space in coronal section, skin left, head up (crop of the approved chest tube rib painting).
teachingPoint: Enter the posterolateral chest at the ultrasound-marked site, as lateral as the target allows, just over the top of the lower rib.
claims: Seated leaning forward over a bedside table with arms on a pillow (record positioning). Posterior-lateral approach on the patient's right (record: posterior-lateral approach; stay as lateral or anterior as the target allows).
The site is a typical one below the scapular tip; its level is set by ultrasound (record: mark the optimal pocket).
Needle along the superior margin of the lower rib, clear of the vein, artery and nerve under the rib above (record).
Inset reuses the approved chest_tube_rib_anatomy painting.
Labels: Marked site, Vein, artery, nerve, Needle, Lower rib.
